responsibility: Defines the baseline PA-RISC HP-UX target personality shared by HP-UX variants. It marks the target as HP-UX, fixes core ABI type definitions and long-double behavior to match HP-UX headers and libraries, supplies HP-UX-specific preprocessor builtins and feature macros, and customizes default libraries, linker options, unwind-library compatibility, and libc capability assumptions so the generic PA backend emits code and driver specs suitable for HP-UX.
same_name_distinction: Header-side HP-UX configuration for PA: unlike pa-hpux.opt, it hardwires ABI, preprocessor, library, and linker-spec macros for the base HP-UX target, whereas the .opt file only declares user-selectable options and the flag_pa_unix variable those specs consult.
